concerns.text: Task T016 (Implement logging to quality_log.json) is marked incomplete and placed in Phase 1/2 boundary, but it is a consumer of data-quality warnings generated by T005b (handle_gaps) and T020a (pipeline). T016 must be moved to Phase 6 (Testing & Validation) or explicitly linked as a dependency of T099a (Execute pipeline) to ensure the logging mechanism exists before the pipeline attempts to write to it. Currently, T099a expects `quality_log.json` to be created, but the task to implement the writer (T016) is not guaranteed to run before T099a.

Task T020b (run_analysis_pipeline) lists dependencies on T004a-T011, but T016 (logging implementation) is missing from this dependency list. Since T020b is expected to produce the JSON report (FR-009) which includes data-quality warnings, it implicitly depends on the logging infrastructure implemented in T016. Without T016 preceding T020b, the pipeline will fail to log warnings as required by FR-009.

Task T062 (Update sensitivity.py to output 'trend' field) is placed in Phase 7 (Polish) but depends on the core sensitivity logic in T011. If T062 introduces a new output field ('trend') required for the final report, it must be executed before T099a (Execute pipeline) and T028 (Integrate sensitivity). Currently, T028 and T099a may run before T062, resulting in a report missing the 'trend' field if that field is considered part of the final deliverable.

Tasks T060 and T061 are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but are documentation tasks that depend on the completion of the core analysis (US-1, US-2, US-3) to accurately describe the implemented mechanisms and reference frames. While they don't block code execution, marking them as parallel to the core pipeline implies they can be done simultaneously with the analysis, which risks describing unimplemented or changed logic. They should be sequenced after the core analysis tasks (T020b, T027) to ensure accuracy.
